# /camayoc:record

Run `cy record $ARGUMENTS` and report its output faithfully.

- `recorded`, `unchanged` or `superseded`: done; quote the IRI.
- `Not recorded: ...`: each line names a missing or bad field. Supply it from the conversation and run again; ask the user only for facts you do not have.
- `queued`: quipu was unreachable; say so, and run `cy flush` later.
- `cy record <entity> --help` lists every flag.

| Entity | Required flags |
| --- | --- |
| decision | `--chose` `--by` `--about` `--topic` |
| directive | `--rule` `--issued-by` `--applies-to` `--topic` |
| handoff | `--agent` `--next` |
| preference | `--person` `--prefers` `--context` `--topic` |
| reference | `--subject` `--topic` `--locator` |
